user.title: Connect a car to gdanav
user.description: Pick your car's device in Home Assistant (for example the Leapmotor one): gdanav recognises battery, range, charging, temperatures, speed, power and odometer by itself. You can check and fix everything in the next step. If the car has no device, leave it empty and pick the entities by hand.

entita.title: The car's entities
entita.description: Entities recognised: {trovate}. Check, fix if needed and confirm. Only the battery is required. Then open the gdanav device: scan the QR code with the app, or press «New pairing code» and type the code in the app.

data_description.relay: Keep the default unless you run your own relay.

error.relay_non_valido: The relay must start with wss:// (or ws:// for testing).

init.title: Commands from the app
init.description: The scripts, buttons and scenes the app may run, such as preconditioning. The app can do nothing else.

pianifica_viaggio.name: Plan trip
pianifica_viaggio.description: Sends a trip to the app, which works out the route and charging stops.

config_entry_id.name: Car
config_entry_id.description: If you have more than one. Empty: all of them.
